$comment: The shape of a curation manifest for pnpm curate:pilot -- --manifest <path>. A real manifest names people by email, so it is private and is not in the repository. Every $comment is ignored.

retire.$comment: Set retiredAt on each row found by slug. Retiring a community retires its same-slug vocabulary in the same transaction. A slug that is not found is reported and skipped. A retired row keeps its slug, so a study below may not reuse one retired here.

communities.$comment: Created by slug when absent. terms is optional; each stable term slug listed there moves the existing term and its complete history into this community's same-slug vocabulary, while its former route becomes an alias. Each member is added by email when they have no live episode; an existing member is left as they are. addedAt is now when absent, a date or a date-time with its offset, or first-act-2025, the person's earliest definition, comment or vote of 2025.
communities.title: Metadata Research Center
communities.description: The research group running the pilot.

communities.$comment: A second community can own a disjoint historical corpus. The term slugs identify existing rows; this operation never clones their definitions or activity.
communities.title: ID4
communities.description: The community represented by the historical study record.

collections.$comment: Created by slug when absent, curated. Each term is asserted as a member when it is not one already. Prefer { vocabulary, slug } stable references. A legacy text label is still matched case-insensitively when it is unique across all vocabularies; an ambiguous label is refused. The createdBefore selector remains available for old manifests.
collections.title: MRC pilot terms
collections.description: The four terms the pilot walks.

collections.$comment: New manifests should freeze historical sets as qualified routes. Older manifests using { createdBefore } still parse unchanged, but that selector intentionally spans the whole catalog.
collections.title: ID4 terms, 2025

studies.$comment: Created by slug when absent, over a community and a collection named above or already in the database. contentKey resolves the reviewed title and welcome text under content/studies. walkthrough generates the steps as the steward's Generate button does, only while the study has none: questions is default for the two closing questions, or a list of { prompt, responseKind } with responseKind text or scale. A study that has already closed gets no walkthrough.
A study over its past window records what happened then: it is created closed, with no walkthrough.
